en: Black‑and‑white view down a broad urban street lined with richly decorated late‑19th‑century buildings. At the left corner stands a three‑storey hotel with a mansard roof and painted wall sign. Several people with handcarts and a cyclist move along the cobbled street; gas streetlamps and trees line the sidewalks. The architecture features ornate facades and spires typical of historic German cities.
